name: Sindhudurg Fort
description: Sindhudurg Fort is a massive sea fortress built by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj between 1664 and 1667 AD on an island off the Malvan coast. Known for its hidden entrance, strong ramparts, and the only temple dedicated to Shivaji Maharaj.

entryFee.note: No entry fee, only boat charges

history.brief: Built between 1664-1667 AD by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj to establish Maratha naval power and counter foreign invasions along the Konkan coast.
history.significance: Birthplace of Indian naval power. Houses the only temple of Shivaji Maharaj.
famousBattles: Naval defense against Portuguese, Dutch, and British forces
Strategic resistance against Siddis of Janjira
